notes: This software archive provides the ESP32-S3 implementation of a public curve-event glucose Transformer. Raw CGM records, trained weights, and credentials are not redistributed.
description:
Pico-Former is an on-device curve–event glucose Transformer for ESP32-S3. One Core-1 forward pass emits a 48-point trajectory and 16 Flash-threshold event flags. Core 0 serves wireless I/O. Tokenization, residual-on-inertia, and the frozen τ protocol follow the public RICE-Former archive (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.22171786).

Included materials

  • ESP32-S3 firmware: self-attention, cross-attention, residual glue, dual-core I/O
  • Host scripts to export weights from an authorized checkpoint and to audit the board over serial
  • Aggregate AZT1D holdout tables and on-board identity summaries (19,152 windows)
  • Documentation for data access and reproducibility

Not included

Raw CGM records, participant event logs, trained weights (ceqt_weights.h), Wi-Fi credentials, and caches.

Software repository: https://github.com/modalfuse/pico-former
